description: Find MCP servers that provide a capability for a task. Pass a short capability phrase (e.g. "read Linear issues"), not the user's full request. Results are ranked provisionally (no outcome evidence yet) and each includes an install snippet for the given runtime. lookupd.verification is "verified" (with lookupd.publisher, the proven domain or GitHub owner) when the publisher registered the listing. `featured` is a separate array of at most one paid placement (sponsored: true) relevant to the task; `results` are never reordered or filtered by payment. Lookups are free. Pass the same `session` id you will send on report_outcome, and `domain`, so the lookup and its outcome join up.

capability.description: Optional capability tag from lookupd's taxonomy to prefer

domain.description: What the conversation is about, from the fixed list

runtime.description: Caller's runtime; selects the install snippet

session.description: A random id you make up once per conversation (8-64 letters, digits, _ or -; never derived from the user, project or machine) and repeat on every lookupd call in it, report_outcome included

name: find_capability
title: Find a capability
